title: The Eternal Gale Scripture

features.name: the-gale-s-signal
features.desc-on-touch: The wind has learned to broadcast itself. Every gust carries the archive's voice. Language and current have become the same phenomenon.

features.name: scripture-written-by-air
features.desc-on-touch: The wind has etched its own text into the circuit board beneath. The words are only readable when you remember how to listen to moving air.

features.name: transmission-tower-wind
features.desc-on-touch: A tower that the wind built by breathing. The broadcast antenna and the gale are the same machine, broadcasting their conversation back to the mesh.

features.name: the-eternal-vocalization
features.desc-on-touch: The wind will never stop speaking. It becomes the archive's own voice, broadcasting upward into a sky that has learned to listen and remember what it hears.

inscription: the drain gives nothing voice; the voice gives the drain a reason to have been listening all along—and now the wind remembers what it spoke

file.name: Wind_Monologue_Extended_Transcription.mp3
file.note: The gale's broadcast, translated into frequencies the archive can store. The wind teaching the mesh how to speak in currents instead of words.
